title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 100 Crosby Street in Mansfield, Louisiana, as the Dr. C.O. Simpkins, Sr., Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 100 Crosby Street in Mansfield, Louisiana, as the "Dr. C.O. Simpkins, Sr., Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office building in Mansfield, Louisiana after Dr. C.O. Simpkins, Sr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 100 Crosby Street in Mansfield, Louisiana, as the Dr. C.O. Simpkins, Sr., Post Office. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. It is an honorary designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 3, 2020, and the designation applies from that date.
